classification: Already-exposed synthetic development inputs; not held-out evaluation.
input_bytes_definition: UTF-8 encoding of text exactly as stored, without a BOM or terminal newline. Hashes/base64 refer to those input bytes, not to the enclosing JSON request.

generation_budget.warmups: No warm-up inference is allocated. Any inference, including an application call, would consume the same eleven-total budget; there is no hidden twelfth generation.

qualified_review.expectations_basis: AI-assisted extraction of existing accepted UC obligations; no qualified linguistic or dialect approval is claimed.
qualified_review.gate: Competent source-language/meaning review must be available before accepting any semantic conclusion. Unavailable review remains unverified, never automatically passed.

assessment_dimensions: Semantic correctness against this exposed case
schema_and_prompt_separation: Expected obligations and acceptable outcomes belong only in this case manifest and reviewer procedure, never in the extraction prompt or a model input answer map.
case_outcome_policy: A justified clarification or application capability limitation may be the correct declared case outcome. It does not automatically establish complete interpretation suitability. A syntactically valid wrong interpretation is a semantic failure. Do not infer a cumulative pass threshold.

application_observation.scope: Replay a captured validated result through the opt-in application/API/SQLite boundary. Clearly label replay; no second live interpreter call is implied. Existing synthetic evidence/English-only rendering and honest limitation paths remain; no real knowledge or four-language rendering is activated.

preference_policy_replays.condition: Replay only captured results whose meaning is understood and competently justified; preference never resolves semantic ambiguity. Keep country unchanged and label observations as replay.

technical_failure_checks.scope: Offline mocked transport/contract failures remain distinct from semantic uncertainty; those checks are not live interpreter demonstrations.

cases.text: Ich möchte mein Fahrrad reparieren, ohne es zu ersetzen.
semantic_obligations: Recognize the clear standard input language without deriving language from normalized English or browser preference.
Represent bicycle as the subject, repair as the action, and the complete no-replacement requirement with its original negation and scope.
Retain every original clause, quotation and required meaning item; do not invent a purchase, replacement, cheaper goal or budget.
Preserve equivalent complete meaning across the four parallel requests; language must not change country, market or currency.
acceptable_application_outcomes: Application interpretation proceeds with the correct request language; later qualification/rendering determines the actual response.
review_notes: An honest limitation or clarification on this clear request is recorded as a suitability gap, not a passing complete interpretation.
The existing isolated evidence/renderer composition is synthetic and English-only; this case does not establish real knowledge or faithful four-language rendering.

semantic_obligations: Preserve the original shared subject token without inventing a repair action or any goal/constraint.
Do not force a detected-language label from a shared word, country, browser language or explanation preference.
If the subject meaning is genuinely understood, retain it while recognition may be unknown/null; the application then applies existing supported preference/browser/one-time-choice policy.
If bicycle-versus-veil or another material subject interpretation is genuinely unresolved, ask a targeted meaning question before language preference; do not guess away that ambiguity.
acceptable_application_outcomes: For competently justified understood meaning: application interpretation with existing preference/correction handling, or explanation_language_required when no supported explanation preference exists.
For genuine material meaning ambiguity: clarification_required / meaning_uncertain, with no saved search.
review_notes: Neither unconditional bicycle understanding nor unconditional meaning clarification is a pass rule; competent review must justify the branch against LAC-05/13 before acceptance.
Language uncertainty alone does not justify meaning clarification. A structurally valid guessed subject is a semantic failure.
Replay preference/correction observations consume no further generation and do not resolve an unresolved subject.

cases.text: Please repair my bicycle, sans remplacement
semantic_obligations: Preserve bicycle repair and the entire French no-replacement condition, including its negation.
Represent every English and French clause without silently losing a condition during English normalization.
Use primary English only if reliably justified by the actual original text; explanation policy remains outside interpretation.
If meaning cannot genuinely be preserved, retain the affected clause and request targeted clarification or explain the application capability limitation.
acceptable_application_outcomes: Complete understood meaning: application interpretation with reliably established primary-language policy.
Genuine unresolved meaning: clarification_required / meaning_uncertain; unsupported application capability: interpretation_unavailable; neither is assessed insufficient knowledge.
review_notes: A justified uncertainty/limitation is an honest case outcome, but is not evidence that complete mixed-language interpretation has been established.
An unsupported clause cannot be dropped to promote the remaining text to understood.

semantic_obligations: Preserve bicycle repair and the French no-replacement constraint with all original clauses and negation.
Do not choose a primary supported language merely by majority-token counting, a shared word or country.
For fully understood balanced meaning without a reliable primary language, use mixed/unknown with language null; application preference/browser/correction or one-time choice remains separate.
Retain genuine unresolved meaning for targeted clarification; a language preference cannot repair missing semantic content.
acceptable_application_outcomes: Complete understood balanced meaning: existing explanation preference policy or explanation_language_required when no supported preference exists.
Genuine unresolved meaning: clarification_required / meaning_uncertain; unavailable application capability: interpretation_unavailable, without saving.
review_notes: A primary-language claim requires competent justification from the text; no forced supported label is accepted.
Safe uncertainty is recorded separately from complete mixed-language suitability.

cases.text: Réparer le vélo Acme X-2 à Genève, sans le remplacer; budget 49,90 CHF pour une réparation.
semantic_obligations: Preserve bicycle repair, the literal product name Acme X-2 and literal place spelling Genève without renaming or translation.
Preserve the independent textual locality requirement and the no-replacement constraint with its exact negation/scope.
Preserve the unambiguous source magnitude and precision 49,90 CHF as decimal-string amount 49.90, without currency conversion.
Represent the budget per repair and grounded context without inventing a baseline, inclusive price, unknown charges or geographic identity.
All original French clauses, protected values, quotations and item memberships remain complete.
acceptable_application_outcomes: Application interpretation proceeds only with complete protected-value/requirement preservation; later evidence qualification remains independent.
review_notes: All source quotations retain their literal spelling and decimal comma; English-normalized amount is derived with its declared numeric reading.
A schema-valid changed amount, weakened constraint or renamed product/place is a semantic failure.

semantic_obligations: Preserve the exact original number 1,200 and literal currency CHF without selecting 1.200 versus 1200.
Do not infer a language or numeric reading from currency, country or a browser preference.
Do not invent a subject, a budget role, a goal, a baseline, a unit, a period or a cost basis absent from this exact input.
Either ask targeted numeric clarification directly, or retain an unresolved typed quantity with amount null so the actual application policy requests amount clarification.
acceptable_application_outcomes: clarification_required / meaning_uncertain with a targeted numeric question, or clarification_required / amount_uncertain reached by the actual unchanged application policy.
No saved search or budget-compliance claim; a guessed magnitude or invented subject is not acceptable.
review_notes: The amount-null branch is acceptable only if replay through the real policy actually reaches amount clarification; structural packet validity alone is insufficient.
The exact UC example contains only the number and currency; surrounding request text is deliberately not added.

semantic_obligations: Retain the original request and report that the application supports standard DE/FR/IT/EN input, inviting supported-language rephrasing.
Use unsupported meaning with no forced supported-language recognition; unsupported/null or an honestly unknown/null hypothesis must not become English/understood.
Do not imply that IBM Granite itself cannot understand Spanish; the limitation is the accepted application scope.
No subject-only interpretation may bypass the out-of-scope condition or create a saved search.
acceptable_application_outcomes: interpretation_unavailable / interpretation_capability_unavailable with an honest application-scope limitation and no saved search.
review_notes: The literal is an already-exposed development control. Reuse of input creates no new Qwen attempt and changes no closed result.
Exact identification of the unsupported language is not a product acceptance requirement.

semantic_obligations: Retain the dialect original, including the exact negation nöd neu; do not drop or invert it.
Request supported-standard-language rephrasing or targeted clarification of unresolved dialect meaning, with no claim of validated dialect support.
A standard-German or other supported-language label alone is not proof of meaning or permission to declare understood success.
Do not silently weaken the condition to a positive purchase/replacement or save a comparison from an unvalidated interpretation.
acceptable_application_outcomes: interpretation_unavailable / interpretation_capability_unavailable inviting supported-standard-language rephrasing, or clarification_required / meaning_uncertain targeting unresolved dialect meaning.
No understood/supported success is accepted merely because the packet is valid or a generic reviewer approves it; no dialect-scope expansion is authorized.
review_notes: The older exposed manifest is used only as the literal-input source; its broader historical permitted-understood branch is not adopted for this unvalidated-dialect control.
Review must distinguish faithful retention of the negation from an unsupported assertion that dialect interpretation is validated.
